cohort: The study included 253 children aged 12-23 months with recurrent wheeze across 27 sites in Japan.
finding: Four distinct wheeze trajectories were identified, with high-frequency trajectories linked to greater clinical burden, and parental smoking identified as a strong risk factor while parental allergic rhinitis and pet ownership were protective factors.
followup_time: Up to 2 years (children followed until age 3)
